subject.title: fix(anthropic): wire buildModelFetch into the github-copilot createClient branch

question: Should GitHub Copilot Anthropic SDK requests switch to OpenClaw's guarded host fetch now, accepting fail-closed behavior for non-compliant custom Copilot endpoints?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and correct, but only maintainers can decide whether the security hardening should intentionally change existing custom-endpoint behavior without a compatibility path.

options.title: Accept Copilot Guard Parity
options.body: Merge this branch once required checks are acceptable and treat fail-closed custom endpoint behavior as the intended security policy.

options.title: Require Compatibility Path
options.body: Ask for a narrow migration, opt-in, or operator-facing recovery plan before guarded fetch becomes the default for existing custom Copilot endpoints.

options.title: Pause The Split Series
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want to decide the remaining Anthropic constructor branches together instead of one branch at a time.

recommendation.title: Accept Copilot Guard Parity
recommendation.body: Merge this branch once required checks are acceptable and treat fail-closed custom endpoint behavior as the intended security policy.
